verdict.rationale: Lever's own Automation Hub, positioned for high-volume hiring, handles archiving, tagging, emailing and advancing candidates. Its nurture feature automates outreach 'at scale'. Together these suggest actions applied across many candidates, but nothing documents explicit multi-select bulk actions or bulk API endpoints. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-select/bulk-edit UI documentation, bulk API operations, scope and limits of bulk actions, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Lever's Automation Hub handles routine tasks like archiving, tagging, emailing, and advancing candidates.
